RangeType.description_en:
The type of the restorable time range. Valid values:

point: a discrete point in time that corresponds to a full backup.

range: a continuous time range. You can restore data to any point in time within this range

可恢复时间段类型，返回值如下：
point：该时间段为全量备份离散时间点。
range：该时间段为连续备份时间段，可指定任意时间
